{{Otheruses|Claw}}
A '''claw vine''' was a type of predatory plant. They were neither insectivores or [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]], but instead fed off the rotting bodies of anything they could catch. They had no visual organs, but instead had motion-sensitive fibres on their vines.
